column1: # Energy Research Warehouse (ERW): the hours behind What a generator earns; the default case of /cost-of-power/seller (session 183)
# Case: ERCOT; solar; priced at the hub average HB_HUBAVG in real time; per 1 MW of installed nameplate (the page's default size is 100 MW). A fleet average: not a site

# Window: local (Central) months 2018-07 to 2026-10; every hour of the model's snapshot from 2018-07-01T05:00:00Z to its last hour 2026-10-03T04:00:00Z. in_last_twelve = 1 marks 2025-10 to 2026-09: the last twelve months of the model and of the capture price alike (the same months; so one flag is kept)

# Rows: one per hour that holds a real-time price; every hour of the window holds one (72384 rows). hour_utc is the hour's start; local_day and local_month are the hour's day and month in America/Chicago
# price_usd_mwh: the hour's real-time settlement point price in USD per MWh; the mean of its four 15-minute prices; held only when all four are

# solar_mwh: the solar generation of ERCOT's whole fleet in the hour in MWh (EIA-930; balancing authority ERCO; column Adjusted SUN Gen). nameplate_mw: the solar nameplate installed in ERCO at the start of the local month in MW (EIA-860M operating and retired generators; vintage 2026-08)
# Sentinel: -99999 in solar_mwh means EIA's value for the hour is blank (72 hours); such an hour is in no sum. No other column holds a sentinel

# The model (What a generator earns): output per MW = solar_mwh / nameplate_mw; a month's revenue per MW = the sum of price x output over its hours with a value; a month is held when those hours are at least 0.90 of the hours in the local month

# The capture price: generation-weighted price = sum(price x generation) / sum(generation); flat average = sum(price) / hours; over the hours with a value in the local months from 2019-01; a month counts at 0.95 of its hours. Its price and its generation are these two columns: equal on every hour it uses (67943 hours compared at export); so one column of each is kept

# Source tables (ERW; warehouse/output): ercot_all_hub_prices_history; iso_rtm_hub_prices; eia860m_operating_generators; eia860m_retired_generators. Workbook: warehouse/raw/eia930_emissions/20261004T021545Z/20261004T021615.318504Z_00004_ERCO.xlsx from https://www.eia.gov/electricity/gridmonitor/knownissues/xls/ERCO.xlsx (last modified Sat 03 Oct 2026 16:04:39 GMT; retrieved 2026-10-04T02:15:45Z)

# Retrieved (UTC) as each table's own header states: iso_rtm_hub_prices 20261008T141137Z; ercot_all_hub_prices_history 20260926T000958Z; eia860m_operating_generators 20260926T000340Z; eia860m_retired_generators 20260926T000340Z
